result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page: a truncated restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section and a partially cut-off card at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated, cutting off the end of the name (likely 'Piccolo' or similar).
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout or text truncation to display the full restaurant name, or add an ellipsis if truncation is intentional.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is partially cut off, making the image and any text below it appear incomplete within the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Either ensure the card is fully visible above the fold or make it clearly scrollable; if using partial reveal as a scroll cue, verify enough of the card is visible to communicate interactivity.
